description: Generate exact-pinned Expo Router/React Native/Node LTS/TypeScript scaffold with project-local pnpm manifest/lockfile, unique Android package placeholder (com.example.exposubscriptionapp), EAS profiles (development/preview/production), .gitignore, app.config.ts, and matching starter.json. Covers subtasks 4.1 from tasks.md.
steps: Create expo-subscription-app/ directory at repository root

Create package.json with exact-pinned dependencies: expo (SDK 53.x latest stable), expo-router, react-native, react, react-dom, TypeScript, and all required Expo modules (expo-secure-store, expo-sqlite, expo-linking, expo-constants, expo-status-bar, expo-splash-screen). Include @sentry/react-native, react-native-purchases (RevenueCat), @supabase/supabase-js. Dev deps: jest, @testing-library/react-native, fast-check, eslint, @types/*, typescript, expo-dev-client. Use pnpm@10.28.1 as packageManager. Scripts: dev, lint, typecheck, test, export, eas:config, start
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml

Create app.config.ts with dynamic config: name 'Expo Subscription App', slug 'expo-subscription-app', scheme 'exposubscription' for deep links, android.package 'com.example.exposubscriptionapp', android.adaptiveIcon config, ios.bundleIdentifier 'com.example.exposubscriptionapp', plugins for expo-router/expo-secure-store/expo-sqlite/sentry
Create eas.json with development (developmentClient: true, distribution: internal), preview (distribution: internal), and production (autoSubmit: false) profiles
Create .gitignore excluding node_modules, .expo, dist, android, ios, *.local, .env.local, .env.*.local

Create starter.json matching catalog entry id=25: folder expo-subscription-app, family Expo Mobile, useCase Premium mobile SaaS, framework Expo Router, runtime Node LTS, technologies [TypeScript, React Native, Supabase, RevenueCat, Sentry], auth Supabase Auth, data Supabase + SQLite, monetization RevenueCat, integrations [Sentry]
Create minimal app/ directory structure with app/_layout.tsx root layout using Expo Router Stack, app/(auth)/_layout.tsx, app/(app)/_layout.tsx for authenticated group, and placeholder index routes
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, Expo/React Native path aliases, and appropriate module resolution
Create jest.config.js configured for React Native with transformIgnorePatterns for expo/react-native modules, moduleNameMapper for asset mocks
Create eslint.config.mjs with TypeScript and React Native rules
acceptance_criteria: expo-subscription-app/package.json exists with all required dependencies pinned to exact versions
expo-subscription-app/pnpm-lock.yaml exists and is consistent with package.json
expo-subscription-app/app.config.ts exports valid Expo config with android.package com.example.exposubscriptionapp and scheme exposubscription
expo-subscription-app/eas.json defines development, preview, and production profiles
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds from the starter folder
tsc --noEmit succeeds (no type errors in scaffold)
expo export --platform android completes without errors
